_note: Patch fragment for project-context init/update: stated once per project and frozen into every run. A run settles each part before UI or resource work is registered: state it, or name it under declined with the reason the target does not take it (declined maps copy and/or parameters to that reason; a part is stated or declined, never both). This note is not part of the value. copy says where files the target loads as they are go: root is an absolute directory inside target_root; path is relative to it and contains {name} (also {kind}, {ext} with its dot, {variant}, {density}); accessor is how target code names the copy and may also use {path}; formats lists what the target loads unchanged, from png, webp, jpg, gif, vector-xml, animation-json, nine-patch or a bare file suffix; density is the order in which one rendition of a picture is preferred (base names the unqualified one). A resource in another format, or one whose chosen rendition is declared by several files, stays an authored Resource item. parameters says how recorded values are written: file is the generated file of one module, an absolute path inside target_root that contains {module}; header and footer are literal text in which {module} is replaced; lines gives one line per value type (dimension, number, color, string, and optionally dimension:<unit> for one unit) from {key}, {value}, {unit}, {argb}, {quoted} and {id}; accessor is how target code names one key, from {key} and {module}; locales maps a legacy qualifier to the file that locale's texts are written to (also containing {module}); string_escapes maps a character to what the target's string syntax writes for it. path, accessor and line templates take no literal braces.
